title: Equivariant min-max theory and the spherical Bernstein problem in $\mathbb{S}^4$
summary: We construct an embedded non-equatorial minimal hypersphere in the unit $4$-sphere $\mathbb{S}^4$, which provides a new resolution of Chern's spherical Bernstein problem in $\mathbb{S}^4$. The construction is based on our equivariant min-max theory for $G$-invariant minimal hypersurfaces with reduced genus bound, where $G$ is a compact Lie group acting by isometries on a closed Riemannian manifold with $3$-dimensional orbit space.
